original.note: The golden file is the unmodified library's output on the ESP32-C6: the 96-byte HID descriptor and the four 19-byte input reports after fixed call sequences. Report-pack times are not comparable between boards (each core was written by a different agent), so they are reported, not budgeted.

check.pass: Within 12 s the board prints one FRL-GP1 block, and its MAP line and RPT1 to RPT4 lines are byte for byte the golden lines.

esp32c6.build_note: Arduino sketch harness/frl_gp_check.ino with the library at the commit above; the arduino-cli commands are in boards/esp32c6/README.md and are not scripted.
esp32c6.flash: esptool write-flash of the sketch's build folder (bench.py, kind esp). Board A is the house Bluetooth proxy: restore its full flash backup afterwards.

nucleo-u083rc.flash: STM32_Programmer_CLI over SWD, write and verify; the console is the ST-LINK virtual COM port.

mspm0g3519.build_note: No scripted build in the repo: boards/mspm0g3519/ has frl_gp1.c, frl_gamepad.c and frl_gp1.syscfg, and flash_and_read.sh flashes ticlang/frl_gp1.out, which is not tracked.
mspm0g3519.flash: OpenOCD over the XDS110; see boards/mspm0g3519/flash_and_read.sh.

cc2340r5.flash: DSLite flash of the .hex without verify (CC23xx; bench.py drops -v for this board).
cc2340r5.protected: This board runs a live demo; hil.py flashes it only with --allow-protected.
